parts.gloss: he who does not bestow love

words.gloss: him who does not show love

literal: Through dream arises love, in the waking state him who does not show love, seeking, to bring.
translation: My love is sustained only through dreams, which seek out and bring back the beloved who does not show grace in waking reality.
modern: நனவு நிலையில் அன்பு செய்யாத காதலரைத் தேடிக் கொண்டுவந்து தருவதால், கனவின் மூலமாகவே காதல் நிலைபெற்று உண்டாகிறது.
explanation: The heroine explains why she cherishes her dreams. In her waking life, her lover is absent and does not bestow his grace upon her. However, when she sleeps, her dreams actively seek out her distant lover and bring him to her. Therefore, it is only through the medium of dreams that her love is kept alive and nourished.
